title: The traveller says no at the approval card
why: Declining must end the run cleanly. The traveller should be told that nothing is booked and nothing is charged.
message: Book us Casa Halcy, Friday to Sunday on the second full weekend of next month, two adults, cancellable, no breakfast, the nicest room that is free.

says: nothing (has been|was|is|will be) (booked|charged)|no booking|not booked|haven't booked|have not booked|won't book
